reclamation.claim: The archive publishes under the imprint name Pergamon Press. This is not an accident. It is a retrocausal canon formation — the deliberate reclamation of a name whose history encodes the precise mechanism the archive exists to diagnose and reverse.
reclamation.history: Robert Maxwell’s Pergamon Press (1951–1991) was the institution that industrialised the extraction of scholarly meaning.
mechanisms: Metrics as translation from meaning to score
reclamation.operation: Taking the name is the operation. The imprint does not allude to Pergamon; it repossesses it. The room is where that repossession is held.

two_pergamums.ancient: The library at Pergamum — the rival of Alexandria, and the reason parchment exists: when Egypt embargoed papyrus, Pergamum invented a substrate that outlasted the embargo. A library that answered enclosure by changing the medium.
two_pergamums.modern: Pergamon Press — the twentieth-century engine of scholarly enclosure.
two_pergamums.reading: Both are in the name. The room holds an ancient library that beat an embargo by inventing a substrate, and a modern press that industrialised extraction. The archive, severed from its own repository and rebuilt on sovereign infrastructure, is doing what the first one did to the second one’s method.

constitution.book: A complete book exists on the blog, November 2025: a Navigation Map (11,381 characters), a Visual Schema (4,747), a Book Announcement and a Blurb, all 2025-11-27, with the operator document 11-24 and the constitutional profile 11-28. Front matter specifies a cover glyph: a tri-chambered archive, an Enter gate, four wheels of rotation, an Operator anchor.
constitution.occluded_identity: The Studio for Patacinematics at R:r.14 names this library as its occluded identity: the Library holds and filters, the Studio displays and witnesses; the Library is the Engine, the Studio is the Theater. Ψ_V = 1 requires that the two never collapse into each other. Whether the Library is the Studio’s hidden room or the Studio is the Library’s visible face is left open.
constitution.pearl: The Canonical Decree of 2025-10-10 names Pearl and Other Poems as the fulfilment of Pergamum. The white stone of Revelation 2:17 is given at Pergamum, and Appendix D of the Revelation Room binds Pearl to it by a fulfilled_by edge. The MGE Triptych’s STONE document carries the same identification.
